map.box-shadow 的模糊半径越大，重绘成本越高，在滚动或动画中大量使用会掉帧: The larger the blur radius of a box-shadow, the more expensive the repaint, and using many of them in scrolling or animation can drop frames. Suggestions: add will-change to the animated element or animate transform instead; stacking several small-radius shadows is often both faster and better looking than one large blur.
